req.title: Support all HTTP verbs on /status/<code>
req.statement: The system shall accept GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, and TRACE on /status/<code>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /status/<code> endpoint must support all HTTP verbs and return a 2xx response for valid requests. Tests are designed to verify this behavior across different HTTP methods, including edge cases and invalid inputs.

tests.name: test_status_code_get_200
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/200')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_status_code_post_invalid
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
expected: The response body contains 'Invalid status code'.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/status/invalid')
assert response.status_code == 400
assert b'Invalid status code' in response.data

tests.name: test_status_code_boundary_299
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/status/299')
assert response.status_code == 299
